issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for assembleBookstore: the problem statement and the template expect a parameterless function assembleBookstore() that returns a Bookstore, but the solution implements private static func assembleBookstore(count: Int) -> Bookstore (has a required Int parameter). Additionally, the solution's main() calls assembleBookstore() with no arguments (call site at Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift:5), which is inconsistent with the solution's own implementation and will cause a compilation error. This mismatch confuses students about the intended API and blocks successful compilation/run of the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore API consistent across artifacts. Simplest fix: change the solution implementation signature to private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore (remove the unused parameter) so the call in main() and the template/problem match. Alternatively, if the parameter is required for pedagogical reasons, update the problem statement and template to declare assembleBookstore(count: Int) and update all call sites (or give the parameter a default value, e.g. count: Int = 0) so every artifact uses the same signature.
